regions.cleaned_text: LITTLE FLOWER - ST. THERESE Born Jan. 2, 1873 - Died Sept. 30th 1897. "On that day (Confirmation) I rec'd the gift of fortitude in suffering - a gift I needed sorely, for the martyrdom of my soul was about to begin." " ..... He does not come down from Heaven each day in order to remain in a golden ciborium, but to find another Heaven - the Heaven of our souls in which He takes such delight."
